title: Authorâs Tranquility Press Proudly Publishes Deceitful Intentions: A Revenge Mystery by Carlo Armenise
text:
In Deceitful Intentions: A Revenge Mystery, Carlo Armenise weaves a suspenseful and emotionally charged thriller that follows the journey of Raven Redman, a young woman whose life takes a tragic turn after a devastating car accident. The crash kills her mother, Alice, and leaves Raven severely injured—costing her not only a leg but also her memory. As she struggles to rebuild her life, moving back to her childhood home, she discovers that the accident may not have been an accident at all.
With the help of her loyal best friend, Julia, Raven embarks on a relentless quest to uncover the dark secrets buried beneath the wreckage of her past. As shocking truths unravel, Raven finds herself entangled in a web of deception, betrayal, and danger. But the closer she gets to the truth, the more she realizes that some secrets are meant to stay buried.
Will Raven’s determination for justice bring her closure—or put her in even greater peril?
About the Author
Carlo Armenise delivers a masterful blend of mystery and suspense, crafting a story filled with unexpected twists and unforgettable characters. His ability to explore human resilience in the face of tragedy makes Deceitful Intentions a must-read for thriller enthusiasts.
Uncover the secrets of Deceitful Intentions: A Revenge Mystery—a thrilling read where appearances deceive. Get your copy on Amazon today and visit the author's website at https://carloarmenise.com/.
